_meta.name: Read a Book Last Year (any format)
_meta.unit: percent of adults who read a book, in whole or in part, in any format, past 12 months
_meta.note: "In the past 12 months, about how many books did you read either all or part of the way through?" (print, electronic, or audiobooks) — percent reading at least one. 2011–2021 by live telephone; October 2025 on Pew's American Trends Panel (web). Pew charts the mode change with a dashed segment and notes minor wording adjustment in 2025; the level was unchanged across it (75% in 2021, 75% in 2025). 2012 was asked twice (Jan 75, Oct 74); the annual value is their mean — the only arithmetic here.
_meta.method: transcribed from the October 2025 topline's 'phone trend for comparison' table plus the 2025 reading (read 2026-08-31): 2011 78, 2012 mean(75,74)=74.5, 2014 76, 2015 72, 2016 73, 2018 74, 2019 72, 2021 75, 2025 75
